markets.early_close_condition: This market may close and expire early once USGS has reviewed and finalized all earthquakes from the Period and the highest qualifying magnitude is known.
markets.rules_primary: If the highest USGS-reported earthquake magnitude worldwide during Nov 21, 2026 from 12:00:00 AM through 11:59:59 PM UTC is 7.0 or higher, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: The determining value is the USGS-reported magnitude displayed at Expiration, preferentially moment magnitude (Mw) and otherwise the primary magnitude type reported by USGS. If multiple earthquakes tie for the highest magnitude, all tied earthquakes count. If USGS ComCat is unavailable at Expiration, settlement may be delayed under the Contract contingencies.
markets.title: What will the biggest earthquake be on Nov 21, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' ZECUSDRTI before 5:00 PM EST on Nov 21, 2026 is at least the simple average of the sixty seconds of CF Benchmarks' ZECUSDRTI before 4:45 PM EST on November 21, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Not all cryptocurrency price data is the same. While checking a source like Google or Coinbase may help guide your decision, the price used to determine this market is based on CF Benchmarks' corresponding Real Time Index (RTI). At the last minute before expiration, 60 RTI prices are collected. The official and final value is the average of these prices, rounded to the nearest 4 decimal places.
